_: Name, description and badge live in src/resources/connectors.json so the console and the browser process cannot disagree about them.

notes: Calendly has a single scope. What the token can reach is decided by the authorising user's own permissions, not by the request.
Authorization codes expire after 10 minutes and access tokens after 2 hours - short enough that refresh handling has to be right from the start rather than added later.
Every API call needs the user or organization URI, fetched once from /users/me.

personal_token.label: Personal access token
notes: Calendly documents PATs as the right choice for a personal integration and OAuth for one serving other people.

get_current_user.notes: Returns the URI every other call needs.

rate_limits.note: Documented per endpoint group; returns 429 with Retry-After.
